goal: Generate key art for a 3A open-world or cyberpunk series pilot poster depicting a futuristic night scene in Shanghai, without recognizable commercial logos.

world.theme: Cyberpunk Super City at the Yangtze River Estuary 2099
world.tone: Acid rain, neon, ultra-high density, and humid air reflecting off the river surface.

composition.foreground: Black silhouette of a traveler holding a transparent kinetic umbrella, with faint self-luminous and rainwater sliding tracks on shoulders.
composition.midground: Layered commercial streets extending linearly along the Bund, magnetic levitation routes, and intersecting taxi flows, with a giant underwater dome at the Huangpu's eastern side entering the river mouth.
composition.background: A cluster of towers piercing through the low clouds and mist, with a three-legged suspended gantry crane, and a polyhedral holographic canopy casting pink and purple reflections between the buildings
composition.perspective: Low-angle wide shot looking up, with water on the ground acting as a mirror

lighting.key_light: Building Facade Strip Neon and Drone Formation Navigation Lights Scattering in Rain
lighting.fill_light: Greenish-blue secondary reflections between the river surface and accumulated water on the road.
lighting.atmosphere: Rain strands digitized, puddles on the road with scanned interference patterns, distant lightning afterglow without overpowering the subject

color_palette: Fuchsia, electric cyan, deep墨黑, street amber warning light embellishments
title_safe_area: Approximately one quarter of the top of the screen kept clean with a fog strip for typography

style.rendering: Film-level digital painting, material details down to wet asphalt and wet metal

must_keep: Clear and describable depth of field for the foreground, midground, and background
Main light source from above sign and river surface, direction consistent
No identifiable real company trademarks in Chinese or English
Character occupies less width than the scale of the building.
avoid: Foreground and midground blended into the same grayscale
Excessive detail leading to a lack of breathing space in the image.
The color palette features a fifth highly saturated main color
